objectives.wording: Complete a defined herb grow cycle.
Protect users, plants, and electronics through fail-safe design.
Operate autonomously with controlled resource delivery.
Monitor, store, and interpret system and plant-health data.
Be usable and maintainable by a first-time operator.
Provide a reusable and serviceable product across multiple crop cycles.
